title: Count the Ahris
prompt: Stage 4-1 after levelling to 8, 44 gold, 51 HP. You hold one Ahri with Jeweled Gauntlet and Nashor's. Scouting: two other players are on Blossom Ahri and between their boards and benches you count five copies. The 4-cost pool is 10 per champion. What is the play?

lobby.note: Ahri 2-star, Blossom 5, three items on her
Ahri 1-star plus one on bench, Blossom 3

options.label: Keep the items, pivot the carry to Morgana and Invokers; sell Ahri only when Morgana 2-star is in.
Roll to 10 now for Ahri 2-star before the other two get there.
Hold 50 and hope Seat 6 dies first.

explanation:
Six of ten Ahris are already out of the pool: your one plus their five. You need two more from the four that remain, while two players who are ahead of you on copies also want them, and Seat 3 is already 2-star. Rolling 44 gold into that pool is the worst odds on the table. Jeweled Gauntlet and Nashor's are not Ahri items; they are AP carry items, and Morgana is an uncontested AP carry with an Invoker line nobody is on. Keep Ahri as a body, roll for Morgana and Invokers, and sell Ahri when she is no longer your carry.

Holding 50 and praying is how you go 7th with a 2-star Sett.
principle: Copies out of the pool are the number that decides a contest. Count them before you roll, and pivot on items, not on units.
commonMistake: Racing two players to a unit because you have the items for it, when the items fit a different carry.
